chunks: 3711 - Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Al-Ḥasan ibn Ṣāliḥ al-Thawrī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who dies while a debt is upon him, and a guarantor guarantees it for the creditors, he عليه السلام said: “If the creditors are satisfied with him, then the liability of the deceased is cleared.”

key_terms.الْغُرَمَاءِ: The creditors to whom the debt is owed.
key_terms.دَيْنٌ: A financial debt owed by the deceased.
key_terms.رَضِيَ: To be satisfied or to accept the guarantor.
key_terms.ضَامِنٌ: A guarantor who takes responsibility for paying the debt.

ai.seo_question: If someone dies owing a debt and another person guarantees it, is the deceased absolved of liability?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the debt of a deceased person when another person assumes responsibility for it. If the creditors accept the guarantor, the deceased is released from liability, showing the importance of creditor consent in financial guarantees.
